_doc: Render massing for the Guldensporencollege campus Kaai school building on the Diksmuidekaai (the former Sint-Amandscollege), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1730972 (3182 m2) had 58.4 m from 3D GRB: the height of the old Collegetoren that stood in this footprint until the K Tower replaced it, so the painter made a 12-storey brick block. Street View (Diksmuidekaai and IJzerkaai, look-up only, Tom's feedback 2026-11-14): a long modernist block of 3-4 storeys (~14 m) with dark glass curtain walls in a dark grey frame, a flat roof and a glass entrance box.
